The '''Nercathi clan''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] family on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] dating at least as far back as the [[Republic Dark Age|Dark Age]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], if not further. Among its members was [[Jedi Lord]] [[Newar Forrth]], the protector of Ryloth during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Following the death of Forrth, clan members crafted three beautiful crystallite skulls to comemmorate the Lord. Each skull represented one of the primary Twi'leki tenets - [[Jasshi'rr]], [[Waala]], and [[Keysshi]]. Surviving through the fall of the Republic and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Imperial slavers raided the clan during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. To put an end to the relentless raids the clan allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], supplying much need troops in return for weapons and protection.<ref name="DFS4" />
